name: Bow
description: The Vale bow: shallow, quick, eyes up. Deeper is for lords and for jokes.

name: Wave
description: A hand up. Says nothing, and means: I have seen you and I am not trouble.

name: Laugh
description: Useful at a table, dangerous at a graveside, and the quickest way into a rumour pool.

name: Cheer
description: Both arms up. Villagers answer it; Toll-Knights look at their boots.

name: Dance
description: Three steps of the Naming Day round. Children join in whether you want them to or not.

name: Rude
description: The old Vale insult: two fingers and a turn of the wrist. It is remembered.
